# Audit 05 — Maintainability

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `0564118` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` (`a00803b`).

Scope: clarity, cohesion, duplication, configuration consistency, meaningful test coverage, documentation accuracy and dependency maintenance. Refactoring is recommended only where it addresses a concrete problem found.

## Accepted limitations

| ID     | Observation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| MNT-A1 | Test coverage below 80 % in five files, all CLI/transport boundaries with deliberate `Throwable` catch-alls or vendor stream code: `DeadlineAwareImapProtocol` 47 %, `ReportOpportunityTriageCommand` 67 %, `ReviewOpportunityCommand` 70 %, `ImportOpportunityEmailCommand` 70 %, `WebklexImapMailboxClient` 78 %. The repository gates are aggregate; these files' uncovered lines are mostly error branches. |
| MNT-A2 | ~48 % of processed candidate alerts quarantine as `missing_job_id` (redirect-only template). This is the documented, accepted scope boundary (ADR-004 final decision), not a maintenance defect — but it is the single largest source of "lost" input and should stay visible in status reporting.                                                                                                              |
| MNT-A3 | The project sheet is a 1,700-line append-only as-built record spanning five phases; it is accurate but slow to navigate. Historical sections are intentionally retained.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## Verified strengths (PASS)

- `vendor/bin/pint --test` passed; `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` (level 5, app + tests) 0 errors; `composer validate --strict` valid; `git diff --check` clean.
- Full MariaDB suite: 181 tests, 1,399 assertions passed locally (17.3 s); Playwright: 2/2 passed; Node release tests: 4/4 passed.
- Conventions are consistent: `final readonly` DTOs, backed enums, constructor promotion, explicit return types, `#[Signature]`/`#[Description]` command attributes, factories for every model under test.
- Every `MailboxIntakeErrorCode`, `MailboxMessageStatus`, `MailboxRunStatus`, `EmailParseErrorCode` (except the documented reserved `unsupported_template`) and `TriageErrorCode` case is produced and consumed (grep-verified).
- Documentation is unusually accurate: runbooks, ADRs and the project sheet matched every host observation; the only gap is the roadmap status paragraph (MNT-04). The release runbook had already flagged two untested items — the database restore, which this audit completed in isolation, and the authenticated private-user journey, which **remains untested** (REL-01).
- `.npmrc` `ignore-scripts=true`; `composer setup` uses `--ignore-scripts`; lockfiles committed and coherent (`vue 3.5.43`, `@playwright/test 1.63.0`, `vite 8.3.0`).
- PHPUnit `failOnPhpunitNotice="true"`; the `TestCase` refuses non-`_test` MariaDB targets ([tests/TestCase.php](../../../tests/TestCase.php#L20-L42)).

## Review limits

Test _quality_ was assessed by reading the reviewed application code against test names and a sample of bodies (`ReviewAuthenticationTest`, `PollOpportunityMailboxTest` excerpts, `release-candidate.test.mjs`), not by mutation testing.
